grades: Must be in 8th or 9th grade (or that age) to apply
name: Quasars to Sea Stars (Santa Barbara Museum of Natural History)
org: Santa Barbara Museum of Natural History
what_you_do: A three-to-four year program for high school teens: museum studies classes, learning from scientists, camping and field trips, and volunteering. After 60 community service hours you become a paid Museum employee.
who_can_apply: Students currently in 8th or 9th grade with at least a 2.5 GPA who can give 20 hours a month in the school year and 25 hours a week in summer, and have reliable transportation to the Museum and Sea Center.
pay_detail: Unpaid for the first 60 community service hours, then paid Museum employee shifts. The pay rate is not stated.
duration: 3 to 4 years; stay active year-round until graduation
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications were due April 3, 2026, with in-person interviews in April and orientation week June 21-27, 2026. The page says applications for 2026 opened Feb 1, 2026. Next cycle dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Online application, then an in-person interview. Contact Teen Programs Manager Haylee Rosso at hrosso@sbnature2.org or 805-682-4711 ext. 170.
notes: Only 8th and 9th graders can apply, so start early. Summers are intensive. Dates shown are the 2026 cycle; expect a similar early-spring deadline next year and check the page.
